Create an interactive outcome distribution visualization across discrete steps

Source: R/reals_distribution_steps.R
create_reals_distribution_steps.Rd

Prepares observed state counts or censoring-adjusted (Aalen-Johansen) state occupancy probabilities across discrete steps and renders an interactive Outcome Distribution component in the browser using rtichoke_viz.

Usage

create_reals_distribution_steps(
  data,
  id_col = "id",
  step_col = "step",
  reals_col = "reals",
  reals_order = NULL,
  reals_scale = "auto",
  censoring_heuristic = "excluded",
  title = "Outcome Distribution",
  renderer = "browser"
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame, tibble, or data.table containing subject-step panel data.

id_col

Character string specifying the subject identifier column.

step_col

Character string specifying the discrete step column.

reals_col

Character string specifying the observed outcome/state column.

reals_order

Vector specifying category ordering. If NULL, ordering defaults to factor levels or sorted observed categories.

reals_scale

Character string specifying the state scale ("auto", "nominal", or "ordinal").

censoring_heuristic

Character string specifying the estimation mode: "excluded" (raw observed counts per step) or "adjusted" (Aalen-Johansen state occupancy probabilities under right censoring).

title

Character string specifying the chart title.

renderer

Character string specifying the rendering engine. Currently, only "browser" is supported.

Value

A browsable htmltools tag list rendering the Outcome Distribution chart.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
create_reals_distribution_steps(
  clinical_states_steps,
  censoring_heuristic = "excluded"
)
} # }
